description: A partial function on natural numbers is partial recursive exactly when its graph is \(\Sigma_1\)-definable in the standard natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.partial_recursive_iff_graph_sigmaOne (f : ℕ → Part ℕ) :
  Nat.Partrec f ↔
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.SigmaOneDefinable
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.Graph f)
